### Executive Summary

Rescana has disclosed critical, unpatched security vulnerabilities affecting Kaltura mwEmbed. The identified flaws expose target organizations to potential remote code execution (RCE) and arbitrary file read attacks.

 tracked as CVE-2026-19912 and CVE-2026-19913, these vulnerabilities currently lack official patches. As a result, systems running vulnerable instances of Kaltura mwEmbed face an elevated threat landscape until vendor remediation is made available.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause

Successful exploitation of CVE-2026-19912 and CVE-2026-19913 enables adversaries to read arbitrary files from the host system or execute arbitrary code remotely. Depending on the environment context, this could lead to sensitive data exposure or complete compromise of the affected server.

The underlying root cause, specific vulnerable code paths, and proof-of-concept details have not been disclosed in the provided source material and are not yet confirmed.

### Mitigation & IOCs

Specific vendor mitigations, official patches, and technical workarounds are not provided in the source material and remain not yet confirmed due to the unpatched status of the flaws. Security teams are advised to isolate or restrict access to Kaltura mwEmbed deployments where possible and monitor vendor security advisories for incoming patches.
